title: TNT-buff
description: The explosion crater size grows from approximately 7 blocks to 14 blocks in diameter, making TNT far more effective for large-scale mining.
body:
TNT Buff

TNT Buff increases the explosion power of TNT from 4.0 to 9.0, making explosions more than twice as powerful as in vanilla Minecraft.

Features
Increases TNT explosion power from 4.0 to 9.0
Expands crater size from approximately 7 blocks to 14 blocks
Makes large-scale mining significantly faster
Helps clear large underground areas
Improves Netherite mining efficiency in the Nether
Why use this mod?

Vanilla TNT can feel too weak for large mining projects. TNT Buff makes explosives much more effective, allowing players to excavate large areas with fewer TNT blocks.

Whether you're searching for Ancient Debris, clearing terrain, or digging massive underground bases, TNT Buff saves time and resources while keeping the gameplay simple and familiar.

Requirements
Fabric Loader
Fabric API
Minecraft 1.21.11
